method: Criterion metadata is used as weak relevance labels; compare legacy set-overlap baseline to current BM25 + optional HNSW vector + reranking pipeline.
limitations: Criterion tags come from detected section headings, so these are weak labels, not human relevance judgments.
Queries include criterion IDs and the reranker uses criterion metadata; the measured gains are optimistic by construction.
Gemini vectors were used with exact cosine search; HNSW was unavailable in this Windows environment.
